name: New York City Pigeon Rescue Central (NYCPRC)
region_note: FERAL / URBAN BIRDS (domestic pigeons, king pigeons, doves, waterfowl)
notes: All-volunteer group helping individual urban pigeons. Provides rescue how-to (catching, feeding, string-removal, first aid) and connects finders with experienced members. Encourages finders to bring injured birds to the Wild Bird Fund. Domestic/king pigeons cannot survive released to the wild.
